title: Makamba taxi-motorcyclist resistance to attempted police seizure and later clashes
notes: FORSC January report PDF pages indexed5–6, lines102–121, describes conflict beginning January20 when police officer demanding a bribe tried to seize a motorcycle. Driver and colleagues resisted; officer fired into air; provincial commissioner ordered motorcycle seizures. At least three people injured during subsequent police–driver clashes by end of month. No crowd count >=50 or articulated government/policy demand established. Rejected as qualifying candidate on current evidence, retained for follow-up; no shots/injuries transferred to Mwaro or Ndava state-response fields. January20 marks reported conflict onset, not proven MM protest start; month-end casualty reporting does not establish physical end.
